app.name: Coverly ROMs
app.tagline: Find and add the missing cover art in your ROMs
app.crashed: Something went wrong in the app.

start.dropHint: Or drop a folder or SD card here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reopen: Reopen the library to apply these changes.

notice.migrated: Your earlier library settings were moved into the new settings file.
notice.reset-corrupt: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults are in use. The old file was kept: {backup}
notice.fixed: Some settings were not valid and went back to their defaults ({fields}). A copy of the file was kept: {backup}
notice.future-version: These settings were saved by a newer version; what this version does not know is ignored. A copy was kept: {backup}

general.checkUpdates: Check for updates when the app starts
general.updatesLater: Automatic updates arrive in a later version; these choices are kept for then.

library.ignoredDirsHint: One folder name per line. They are skipped at any depth.
library.ignoredExtsHint: Comma-separated, without dots. Files with these extensions are never taken as ROMs.
library.followSymlinksHint: Art for ROMs inside a linked folder is saved through the link, which can be outside the library folder.

about.license: Licence: AGPL-3.0-only. Coverly ROMs is free software; its name and logo are trademarks (see Trademarks).
about.noTelemetry: No telemetry: Coverly ROMs only contacts the art sources you enable.
about.updates: Update channel: {channel}. Automatic updates arrive in a later version.

library.empty: No ROMs found in this folder.
library.emptyHint: Check that you picked the SD card or its ROMs folder. Warnings: {n}.
library.noMatch: No ROMs match the search and filters.

errors.not-a-folder: This is a file, not a folder: {detail}
errors.unreadable: Coverly ROMs cannot read {detail}. Check its permissions.
errors.no-profile: No known layout was found in {detail}. Pick the SD card root or its ROMs folder.
errors.stale-library: The library was reopened. Try again.
errors.unknown-entry: This ROM is no longer in the library.
errors.art-missing: There is no image for this ROM.
errors.outside-library: This image is outside the library and was not opened.
errors.art-too-large: This image is too large to show.
errors.settings: The settings could not be saved: {detail}
errors.job-running: A fill job is running. Wait for it or cancel it first.
errors.stale-job: That fill job was replaced by a newer one.
errors.network: The art source could not be reached: {detail}
errors.bad-image: This file is not a usable image: {detail}
errors.write-denied: Coverly ROMs cannot write to the library (read-only or no permission): {detail}
errors.name-invalid: This file name is not valid on SD cards: {detail}
errors.volume-gone: The library volume was removed or is no longer reachable: {detail}
errors.keychain-unavailable: This system has no credential store (keychain) Coverly ROMs can use.
errors.keychain-locked: The keychain is locked. Unlock it and try again.

field.order: This must not be higher than the auto-accept threshold.
field.not-absolute: Use a full path (starting with / or a drive letter).

drawer.identifyHint: Look this ROM up in the game databases.
drawer.offline: Offline: identified by its file name only.
drawer.searchLater: Searching by title arrives in a later version.
drawer.noCandidates: No images found for this ROM.
drawer.updated: Art updated. Undo it from Jobs if needed.
drawer.removeConfirm: Remove this image? It is backed up and Undo brings it back.
drawer.busy: A fill job is running: art changes wait until it ends.

fill.title: Fill missing art

strategyHint.rom-region: Prefers the ROM's own region, then the order below.
strategyHint.priority: Prefers the first source, then the order below.
strategyHint.popularity: Prefers the variant that has box, screenshot and title, then source priority.

overwrite.title: Existing art
overwrite.backup: Also replace existing art (with a backup)
overwrite.backupHint: Replaced images are kept in the app's data folder and come back with Undo.

fill.batocera: Batocera and Knulli read art from gamelist.xml, which Coverly ROMs does not update yet: new images may not show until it does.
fill.pausedHint: The dry run paused. Resume it when the connection is back.

pause.rate-limit: Paused: the art server is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and resume.
pause.offline: Paused: no connection to the art server. Resume when you are back online.
pause.volume: Paused: the SD card is full, read-only or was removed. Fix it and resume.

jobs.title: Jobs

state.planned: Dry run ready: nothing written yet.

error.name-invalid: Name not valid on SD cards

jobs.undoConfirm: Undo the last job? Written images are removed and replaced ones restored; images you changed since are kept.
jobs.undone: Undone: {removed} removed, {restored} restored, {kept} kept because you changed them.

review.title: Review doubtful matches
review.variantNote: The best image is a beta, prototype, hack or unlicensed variant: check it before writing.
review.keys: Keys: ← → move · 1–9 choose · Enter accept · S skip · A accept all remaining · Esc back
